contract.acceptance: Every element must satisfy abs(candidate-reference) <= atol + rtol*abs(reference); no relative-L2 or mismatch-rate replacement.
contract.timed_boundary: Model.forward: GDN core plus required official wrapper work (including int64 cu_seqlens to int32 conversion). Input generation, BF16 K normalize, continuation prefix, output allocation/NaN fill and source checks excluded.
contract.minimum_seed_policy: At least six independently seeded inputs per geometric case; deterministic_input_seed records each seed.

baseline.scope: fixed comparison baseline; candidate algorithm and chunk size are unrestricted

inputs.k: BF16 [T,4,128], torch.nn.functional.normalize on BF16 generator output
inputs.initial_state: FP32 [B,32,128,128] in [B,H,V,K] order; zero or continuation
inputs.cu_seqlens: int64 [B+1], starts 0, strictly increasing, ends T
inputs.output: Preallocated BF16 [T,32,128], filled with NaN before calls
inputs.output_state: Preallocated FP32 [B,32,128,128] [B,H,V,K], filled with NaN before calls

contract.input_distribution: Exact pinned gen_qkv: independent row centres Normal(0,0.05), elements Uniform(centre-0.25,centre+0.25), then BF16.

initial_state_scenarios.continuation: Final state of one independently generated 32-token prefix per sequence using pinned reference and the same official numerical contract; excluded from timing

excluded_operations: raw gate projections or softplus/sigmoid gate computation
